title: 第25章 她爱别人第26章 退婚
slug: 领证爽约我转嫁你哥哭什么
content_zh:
第25章她爱别人翌日，唐凝起了个大早。
她起来没看到纪瑾修，还以为他去公司了。
刚掀被子下了床，卧室门忽然打开，纪瑾修从外进来，迈步走到她面前，“醒了。”
唐凝一愣，点点头。
纪瑾修温声，“正好，起来吃点东西，给你手上药。”
唐凝哦了声，又点点头。
她去了浴室，赫然看到放在杯子口上方的牙刷，已经挤好了牙膏。
换做过去，这是她为纪寒做的事。
虽然他们没住一起。
有时候唐凝为了不让他错过重要会议，早早去他家做好早餐，再哄他起床。
她会事先挤好牙膏，搭配好他当天要穿的西装，学着照顾他，做一个合格的女朋友乃至未婚妻。
两人如果相爱，她做这些叫相互体贴照顾。
否则，只能叫自我感动了。
显然，她做的那些对纪寒来说，应该属于后者。
唐凝自嘲地想着，身后传来纪瑾修关心的声音，“怎么了，是手疼了？”
“需要我帮你？”纪瑾修声音不自觉变得紧张。
唐凝回头看着他紧张的目光，愣了会但没多想，很快抿了抿嘴摇头，“没有。”
纪瑾修观察她几秒，平声，“我到楼下等你。”
唐凝冲他微笑，“好。”
他们在一起了一段时间，似乎相处地越来越自然。

唐凝还挺喜欢这种平静自在的日子，很有生活的模样。
……
唐凝洗漱完，换了条长裙下了楼。
纪瑾修坐在客厅等她，听到细微的脚步声靠近，挑眉看去。
只见唐凝穿着淡蓝色吊带收腰及膝长裙，裹着曼妙纤瘦的身材，露出一双笔直的长腿，挽着温柔风的长卷发。
这一身淡蓝色衬得她肤白胜雪，气质温婉明媚。
美中不足的是手上包扎的纱布。
纪瑾修深深看着她，黑眸轻微浮起滚动，黑色衬衣搭配酒红色领带，衬得冷峻的面容愈发深沉禁欲。
他目光一瞬不瞬，发现她能完美驾驭任何衣服的颜色，风格。
尤其傲人的身段，令他不由想起昨晚……
纪瑾修凸起的喉结悄然滚动了几下，放在腿上的手微微收了收，隐忍道，“过来。”
他声音有点沙哑，唐凝顺从地走过去，在他身边坐下后，关心问，“你嗓子怎么了？”
纪瑾修看着她干净的眼眸，反倒觉得刚才的念头太玷污她了。
“没事。”
他收回视线，拿起她受伤的手腕，拆纱布。
好在，昨天处理及时，烫伤处没变严重，再用药几次基本能没事。
纪瑾修拿起药膏，用药用棉签轻轻涂抹在她手背上，细心叮嘱，“今天也不要碰水，好得快。”
他声音温和，动作又细致温柔，指腹的皮肤触碰到唐凝的，让她心里产生了些许异样。
“好了。”纪瑾修松了手，把棉签丢入垃圾桶。
唐凝看着重新被包扎的手，内心莫名一闪即逝的失落。

“我知道了。”唐凝收回手，右手握着他刚才握住的手腕骨上，出了神。
不知为何，她对纪瑾修的感情，好像有点不一样了。
兴许是因为除了父母和爷爷外，她终于在另一个人身上，感受到被关心和在意吧。
纪瑾修看了看她，没说话，吃完早餐去了公司。
唐凝待在家，在客厅桌上写稿子。
content_en:
Chapter 25 She Loves Others The next day, Tang Ning got up early.
She didn't see Ji Jinxiu when she got up, and thought he had gone to the company.
As soon as she lifted the quilt and got out of bed, the bedroom door suddenly opened. Ji Jinxiu came in from the outside and walked up to her, "Wake up."
Tang Ning was stunned and nodded.
Ji Jinxiu said warmly, "That's right. Get up and have something to eat. I'll give you medicine on your hands."
Tang Ning said oh and nodded again.
She went to the bathroom and was surprised to see the toothbrush placed above the mouth of the cup, with toothpaste already squeezed into it.
In the past, this was what she did for Ji Han.
Although they don't live together.
Sometimes, in order to prevent him from missing important meetings, Tang Ning would go to his house early to make breakfast and then coax him to get up.
She would squeeze out the toothpaste in advance, match the suit he would wear that day, learn to take care of him, and be a qualified girlfriend or even fiancée.
If two people love each other, what she does is called caring for each other.
Otherwise, you can only be moved by yourself.
Obviously, what she did should belong to the latter category for Ji Han.
Tang Ning thought mockingly to herself, and Ji Jinxiu's concerned voice came from behind her, "What's wrong? Is your hand hurting?"
"Need me to help you?" Ji Jinxiu's voice became nervous unconsciously.
Tang Ning looked back at his nervous gaze. She was stunned for a moment but didn't think much about it. She quickly pursed her lips and shook her head, "No."
Ji Jinxiu observed her for a few seconds and said calmly, "I'll wait for you downstairs."
Tang Ning smiled at him, "Okay."
They have been together for a while and seem to get along more and more naturally.
Tang Ning quite likes this kind of calm and comfortable life, which looks like life.
…
After Tang Ning washed up, she changed into a long skirt and went downstairs.
Ji Jinxiu was sitting in the living room waiting for her. He heard subtle footsteps approaching and raised his eyebrows.
Tang Ning was seen wearing a light blue sling waist-length knee-length skirt, covering her graceful and slender figure, revealing a pair of straight long legs, and holding gentle long curly hair.
This light blue outfit makes her skin whiter than snow, and her temperament is gentle and bright.
The only fly in the ointment is the gauze bandaged on the hands.
Ji Jinxiu looked at her deeply, his black eyes slightly raised and rolled. His black shirt and burgundy tie made his stern face look even more profound and ascetic.
His eyes never blinked and he realized that she could perfectly control the color and style of any clothes.
His particularly proud figure reminded him of last night...
Ji Jinxiu's raised Adam's apple rolled quietly a few times, the hand on his leg was slightly retracted, and he said patiently, "Come here."
His voice was a little hoarse, so Tang Ning walked over obediently, sat down next to him, and asked with concern, "What's wrong with your voice?"
Ji Jinxiu looked into her clean eyes and felt that the thought just now had tainted her too much.
"It's okay."
He looked away, picked up her injured wrist, and removed the gauze.
Fortunately, the burn was treated in time yesterday and the burn did not become serious. After a few more treatments, it will basically be fine.
Ji Jinxiu picked up the ointment, gently applied it on the back of her hand with a medicinal cotton swab, and carefully warned, "Don't touch the water today, it will heal quickly."
His voice was gentle and his movements were delicate and gentle. The skin of his fingertips touched Tang Ning's, which made her feel a little strange.
"Okay." Ji Jinxiu let go and threw the cotton swab into the trash can.
Tang Ning looked at her hand that had been bandaged again, feeling an inexplicable and fleeting feeling of loss in her heart.
"I know." Tang Ning retracted her hand and held the wrist bone he just held with her right hand, lost in thought.
For some reason, her feelings for Ji Jinxiu seemed a little different.
Maybe it was because besides her parents and grandfather, she finally felt cared for and cared about by another person.
Ji Jinxiu looked at her, said nothing, and went to the company after breakfast.
Tang Ning stayed at home and wrote a manuscript on the table in the living room.
